target.statement: Cluster Purging (CP) F1-score on the Arrhymthia dataset (k-means based, parameter-free variant)

compute.basis: Small tabular ODDS datasets with k-means clustering and O(n) purging; the main cost is installing R and re-implementing/adapting the linked R code plus downloading ODDS data, all CPU-only and minutes per dataset.

blockers: Code link is a shortened URL (tinyurl) that may be dead or point to a repo without exact configs
Exact clustering/perturbation protocol and F1 evaluation details must be reconstructed from the paper
ODDS datasets need to be fetched and preprocessed to match the paper's outlier labels
title: Cluster Purging: Efficient Outlier Detection based on Rate-Distortion Theory
